Public 463 (tag 0D4F, more-morphisms-lemma-deform-projective) and public 465 (tag 07RT, more-morphisms-lemma-pushout-along-thickening) are the closest neighbours: both live in the thickening theory of the same chapter. The first reconstructs a projective thickening together with an ample lift, the second constructs a pushout of a thickening along an affine morphism. Neither states the lifting property that defines a universal first order thickening, and neither is proved by glueing universal properties along a cover.
Public 491 (tag 0E25, more-morphisms-proposition-pushout-along-closed-immersion-and-integral) is a later pushout statement for closed immersions and integral morphisms, a different object again.
Public 486 (tag 0H41, lemma-base-change-scheme-theoretic-image) and public 037 (tag 03H0, Stein factorization) have no overlap with this statement beyond living in the same chapter.
